title: PROPOSED additions to media_buy.features; not published

supports_collection_default_materializat.description: Opt-in native full-bundle default materialization and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least one distinct domain-qualified pair; independent of strict-subset fixtures.

supports_fixed_collection_bundles.description: Opt-in native fixed-collection bundle support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; independent of selectable products.

supports_owner_sold_channel_carriage.description: Opt-in native owner-sold channel carriage support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; no entitlement or authorization assertion.

supports_format_breakdown.description: Opt-in native format-grain reporting support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; no required observed rows.

supports_time_based_views.description: Opt-in native time-threshold view reporting support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; no prescribed thresholds or observations.
